name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Passkey-only OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider backed by an included PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: After deployment, open /setup on your domain right away to create the admin account and register its passkey. The setup page stays open to anyone until the first account exists.
Passkeys only work over HTTPS and are bound to the domain in APP_URL. Changing the domain later invalidates every registered passkey.
